options.text: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron bolts. Switch OFF: it releases the iron bolts.
Switch ON: the electromagnet releases the iron bolts. Switch OFF: it picks up the iron bolts.
Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron bolts and the wooden bead.
Switch OFF: the electromagnet keeps holding the iron bolts as strongly as when the switch was ON.

stem:
The diagram shows Ira's lifting electromagnet on a small crane. A coil on an iron core is joined to a cell through a switch. Iron bolts sit under the electromagnet. A wooden bead sits nearby.

Which prediction is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A lifting electromagnet attracts iron only while current is ON and releases iron when current is OFF. Wood is not picked up.
teacher.figure_note: Crane electromagnet with cell, switch, coil on iron core, iron bolts, and wooden bead.
